verdict.rationale: Channel3's evidence covers developer-side attribution, not the merchant-side capability this story asks for. The search API accepts an optional user identifier so developers can attribute clicks and sales to their own end users, and Channel3 records sales to pay the developer a commission. Neither gives a merchant documented order attribution to the originating agent, or reporting and filtering of transactions by agent.

support.subject: As a merchant, orders are attributed to the originating agent and I can report on or filter transactions by agent
